comparison.objective: Close a hand nutcracker, then sort kernel and shell pieces; candidate calibrates a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Symmetric bimanual handle compression and small-part sorting, not keyed loosening, controlled collar rotation, relocking, or iterative dynamic adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Jaw closure triggers a simulated rigid-body swap, then kernel/shell placement and arm return; both specs agree.
comparison.reason: Although both involve force, the nutcracker tests opposing compression, not parameter adjustment or retention under repeated impacts.
